paragraphs.text: translated by
1. WHEN-men, Brhaspati, giving names to objects, sent out Vak's first and earliest utterances,
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पते प्रथमं वाचो अग्रं यत्प्रैरत नामधेयं दधानाः ।
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agraṃ yatprairata nāmadheyaṃ dadhānāḥ |

paragraphs.text: All that was excellent and spotless, treasured within them, was disclosed through their affection.
paragraphs.original: यदेषां श्रेष्ठं यदरिप्रमासीत्प्रेणा तदेषां निहितं गुहाविः
paragraphs.translit: yadeṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadaripramāsītpreṇā tadeṣāṃ nihitaṃ guhāviḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Where, like men cleansing corn-flour in a cribble, the wise in spirit have created language,
paragraphs.original: सक्तुमिव तितउना पुनन्तो यत्र धीरा मनसा वाचमक्रत ।
paragraphs.translit: saktumiva titaunā punanto yatra dhīrā manasā vācamakrata |

paragraphs.text: Friends see and recognize the marks of friendship: their speech retains the blessed sign imprinted.
paragraphs.original: अत्रा सखायः सख्यानि जानते भद्रैषां लक्ष्मीर्निहिताधि वाचि
paragraphs.translit: atrā sakhāyaḥ sakhyāni jānate bhadraiṣāṃ lakṣmīrnihitādhi vāci

paragraphs.text: 3. With sacrifice the trace of Vak they followed, and found her harbouring within the Rsis.
paragraphs.original: यज्ञेन वाचः पदवीयमायन्तामन्वविन्दन्नृषिषु प्रविष्टाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yajñena vācaḥ padavīyamāyantāmanvavindannṛṣiṣu praviṣṭām |

paragraphs.text: They brought her, dealt her forth in many places: seven singers make her tones resound in concert.
paragraphs.original: तामाभृत्या व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा तां सप्त रेभा अभि सं नवन्ते
paragraphs.translit: tāmābhṛtyā vyadadhuḥ purutrā tāṃ sapta rebhā abhi saṃ navante

paragraphs.text: 4. One man hath ne'er seen Vak, and yet he seeth: one man hath hearing but hath never heard her.
paragraphs.original: उत त्वः पश्यन्न ददर्श वाचमुत त्वः शृण्वन्न शृणोत्येनाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: uta tvaḥ paśyanna dadarśa vācamuta tvaḥ śṛṇvanna śṛṇotyenām |

paragraphs.text: But to another hath she shown her beauty as a fond well-dressed woman to her husband.
paragraphs.original: उतो त्वस्मै तन्वं वि सस्रे जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासाः
paragraphs.translit: uto tvasmai tanvaṃ vi sasre jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. One man they call a laggard, dull in friendship: they never urge him on to deeds of valour.
paragraphs.original: उत त्वं सख्ये स्थिरपीतमाहुर्नैनं हिन्वन्त्यपि वाजिनेषु ।
paragraphs.translit: uta tvaṃ sakhye sthirapītamāhurnainaṃ hinvantyapi vājineṣu |

paragraphs.text: He wanders on in profitless illusion: the Voice he heard yields neither fruit, nor blossom.
paragraphs.original: अधेन्वा चरति माययैष वाचं शुश्रुवाँ अफलामपुष्पाम्
paragraphs.translit: adhenvā carati māyayaiṣa vācaṃ śuśruvām̐ aphalāmapuṣpām

paragraphs.text: 6. No part in Vak hath he who hath abandoned his own dear friend who knows the truth of friendship.
paragraphs.original: यस्तित्याज सचिविदं सखायं न तस्य वाच्यपि भागो अस्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: yastityāja sacividaṃ sakhāyaṃ na tasya vācyapi bhāgo asti |

paragraphs.text: Even if he hears her still in vain he listens: naught knows he of the path of righteous action.
paragraphs.original: यदीं शृणोत्यलकं शृणोति नहि प्रवेद सुकृतस्य पन्थाम्
paragraphs.translit: yadīṃ śṛṇotyalakaṃ śṛṇoti nahi praveda sukṛtasya panthām

paragraphs.text: 7. Unequal in the quickness of their spirit are friends endowed alike with eyes and hearing.
paragraphs.original: अक्षण्वन्तः कर्णवन्तः सखायो मनोजवेष्वसमा बभूवुः ।
paragraphs.translit: akṣaṇvantaḥ karṇavantaḥ sakhāyo manojaveṣvasamā babhūvuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Some look like tanks that reach the mouth or shoulder, others like pools of water fit to bathe in.
paragraphs.original: आदघ्नास उपकक्षास उ त्वे ह्रदा इव स्नात्वा उ त्वे ददृश्रे
paragraphs.translit: ādaghnāsa upakakṣāsa u tve hradā iva snātvā u tve dadṛśre

paragraphs.text: 8. When friendly Brahmans sacrifice together with mental impulse which the heart hath fashioned,
paragraphs.original: हृदा तष्टेषु मनसो जवेषु यद्ब्राह्मणाः संयजन्ते सखायः ।
paragraphs.translit: hṛdā taṣṭeṣu manaso javeṣu yadbrāhmaṇāḥ saṃyajante sakhāyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: They leave one far behind through their attainments, and some who count as Brahmans wander elsewhere.
paragraphs.original: अत्राह त्वं वि जहुर्वेद्याभिरोहब्रह्माणो वि चरन्त्यु त्वे
paragraphs.translit: atrāha tvaṃ vi jahurvedyābhirohabrahmāṇo vi carantyu tve

paragraphs.text: 9. Those men who step not back and move not forward, nor Brahmans nor preparers of libations,
paragraphs.original: इमे ये नार्वाङ्न परश्चरन्ति न ब्राह्मणासो न सुतेकरासः ।
paragraphs.translit: ime ye nārvāṅna paraścaranti na brāhmaṇāso na sutekarāsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Having attained to Vak in sinful fashion spin out their thread in ignorance like spinsters.
paragraphs.original: त एते वाचमभिपद्य पापया सिरीस्तन्त्रं तन्वते अप्रजज्ञयः
paragraphs.translit: ta ete vācamabhipadya pāpayā sirīstantraṃ tanvate aprajajñayaḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. All friends are joyful in the friend who cometh in triumph, having conquered in assembly.
paragraphs.original: सर्वे नन्दन्ति यशसागतेन सभासाहेन सख्या सखायः ।
paragraphs.translit: sarve nandanti yaśasāgatena sabhāsāhena sakhyā sakhāyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: He is their blame-averter, food-provider prepared is he and fit for deed of vigour.
paragraphs.original: किल्बिषस्पृत्पितुषणिर्ह्येषामरं हितो भवति वाजिनाय
paragraphs.translit: kilbiṣaspṛtpituṣaṇirhyeṣāmaraṃ hito bhavati vājināya

paragraphs.text: 11. One plies his constant task reciting verses. one sings the holy psalm in Sakvari measures.
paragraphs.original: ऋचां त्वः पोषमास्ते पुपुष्वान्गायत्रं त्वो गायति शक्वरीषु ।
paragraphs.translit: ṛcāṃ tvaḥ poṣamāste pupuṣvāngāyatraṃ tvo gāyati śakvarīṣu |

paragraphs.text: One more, the Brahman, tells the lore of being, and one lays down the rules of sacrificing.
paragraphs.original: ब्रह्मा त्वो वदति जातविद्यां यज्ञस्य मात्रां वि मिमीत उ त्वः
paragraphs.translit: brahmā tvo vadati jātavidyāṃ yajñasya mātrāṃ vi mimīta u tvaḥ
